tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus 'khor rtsod lan rigs pa'i 'od stong bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru shrī kā la tsakrā ya/ khyab bdag dpal ldan 'gyur med bde ba'i mchog /rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya'i gzi 'bar zhing*/ /srid dang srid min dbyer med mgon de dang*/ /mi gnyis bla ma mchog la gus phyag 'tshal// gangs can 'di na dus 'khor la/ /dmigs pa'i log rtog chu 'dzin las// 'ongs pa'i nyes spyod glog phreng dang*/ /log smra'i ser ba mi bzad pas/ /phan bde'i lo tog 'joms byed pa'i/ /mkhas rlom du ma 'di skad du/ /rgyud sde rtsod bcas yin pas na/ /mkhas pas blang bya ma yin no/ /'di ni dpal ldan zhi ba lhas| |theg chen rtsod bcas phyir zhe na/ /lung la mu stegs pa rnams dang*// lung gzhan la yang rang gzhan dag /rtsod bcas phyir na dor byar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rigs pas legs par bcom/ /gzhung lugs gzhan la mkhas rnams kyis| |blor ma chud pas skyon bcas so/ /theg chen dbu ma chen po de/ /dbyig gnyen thugs su ma chud phyir/ /dbu ma spong bar cis mi byed/ /theg chen nyan thos sde pa yis/ /sangs rgyas gsung du mi 'dod pas/ /byams pa klu sgrub zhi ba lha| |legs ldan 'byed sogs mkhas pa yis/ /theg chen bkar sgrub rigs pa'i tshogs/ /mang du bkod phyir theg chen na/ /rtsod bcas chos su cis mi 'dod| khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg /rgyal ba'i gsung du mi 'dod pa// 'phags yul du yang du ma byung*/ /de phyir mkhas mchog shān+ti pa/ /sogs kyis gsang sngags bka' bsgrub mdzad/ /spyir yang dman pa mi mos pas/ /mchog tu grub ces byams mgon gsungs/ /de phyir mkhas pa gzhon blo yis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsod yig tu/ /bkod pa'i rigs pa ma lus pa/ /ltar snang kho nar kho bos mthong*/ /de yang legs par bshad kyis nyon/ /e waṃ yi ge med pas na| |rtsa rgyud rnam dag min zer ba/ /e waṃ gzugs sam don med zer/ /dang po khyab pa ma grub ste/ /bde mchog la sogs skyon du 'jug

/gnyis pa gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i khrir bzhugs phyir/ khyab ste bshad rgyud rdor phreng las/ /e ni gsang ba mkha' dbyings dang*/ /bha ga pad+ma chos 'byung dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings dang seng ge'i khri/ /mchog tu rmad byung brjod par byed| |waṃ ni rdo rje rdo rje'i sems/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug che/ /he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ /zhes pas gsal bar gsungs phyir ro/ /'dis ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan/ /rgyud sde gzhan du ma smros zhes/ /mu cor smra ba de yang bsal/ /de phyir e waṃ ma smros zhes/ /rtsa rgyud sogs su bshad pa ni/ /e waṃ gzugs la dgongs pa yin/ /'dis ni dus 'khor bde mchog gi /gzhal yas khang la chos 'byung gi /gru gsum dbyibs can mi byed pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan de yang gsal bar bshad/ /mngon shes med pas rtsa rgyud kyi/ /dang po'i 'grel pa bya mi rung*/ /zhes gsungs pa la 'chad po yang*/ /mngon shes dgos pa mtshungs zer ba/ /dang po'i 'chad por sbyor na 'dod/ /mi sbyar khyab pa ji ltar mtshungs/ /skyes bu nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ / 'byung ba 'gro ba'i skye gnas dang*/ /ljon shing dud 'gro'i skye bar bsdus/ /stong pa'i rdul gyi 'jig rten brtsom/ /'di rnams mu stegs gzhung lugs dang*/ / mthun phyir dam chos min no lo/ /des 'dul drang srong rjes bzung phyir/ /de lta'i tha snyad khas len kyang*/ /don rnams cung zad mi bzhed de/ /rtag dngos khas mi len phyir dang*/ /'byung ba nyer len min pa'i phyir/ /ljon shing skye gnas bzhir bsdus pas/ /dud 'gror bsdus par mi 'gyur phyir/ /'jig rten bstan gzhag mngon pa dang*/ /'gal ba'i phyir na mi 'thad do/ /chu 'bab klung la yi dwags rnams/ /rnag khrag shes pa skye ba bzhin/ /sems can so so'i las dang ni| |bags chags stobs kyis dngos po gcig /tshad dby-ibs 'gal bar snang ba 'di/

/lung rigs du mas grub bzhin du/ /tshul 'di sdang smras byed pa'i rgyu| |bag chags ngan pa cis ma yin/ /'on kyang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la/ / dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon yod pa/ /'gog pa lta bur mdzad pa ni/ /des 'dul drang srong bzung phyir yin/ /sgra mi snyan du kla klo dang*/ /rigs ldan 'byung phyir dge sdig gnyis/ /'byung la'ang mngon pas gnod zer ba/ /'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams/ /sher phyin 'chad par 'ong 'gyur zhes/ /sher phyin mdo las bshad pa dang*/ /srog dbang chad pa slar mthud par/ /sman bla'i mdo las bshad pa dang*/ /bud med rten la tshang rgya bar/ /gsang 'dus sogs las bshad rnams la/ /mngon pa'i lung gis cis mi gnod/ /gling bzhi mtha' dag mngon pa dang*/ /mi bstun pa nyid nges bzhin du/ /sgra mi snyan la dogs gcod pa'i| |blo gros 'di 'dra e ma mtshar/ /'dul ba lung las rgyal ba yis/ /rta chag rul pa bzhes pa dang*/ /seng ldeng tshal pa zug pa dang*/ /sgyogs kyis sku rgyab bsnad pa dang*/ /'khor lo'i dbyen gyis gtses pa sogs/ /las kyi lhag mar bshad pa dang*/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor sogs bkag cing*/ /theg chen lung las snang ba dang*/ / las sgrib zad par spangs pa sogs/ /'gal ba spong yang mi shes sam/ /'dzag bde 'khor ba'i rgyur bshad pas/ /tsha dmyal khams gong la sogs na/ /'dzag bde med pas mi 'thad do/ /'dzag bde yin na khams drug can/ /rags pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ /de la yon tan lnga ldan nas/ / gcig ldan bar gyi phra rags su/ /phye nas mi dang lha sogs la/ /rim par sbyar nas gsungs phyir ro/ /des na de ni 'gyur bde yin/ /mi 'gyur bde ba thar lam gyi/ /rtsa bar nges bzhin 'gyur bde ni/ /'khor ba'i rtsa bar cis mi 'dod| |des na don de drang don du/ /bshad pa'ang rgyud la skur 'debs yin/ kun da byang chub sems spong ba/ /rtsa ltung yin na khyim pa yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mi 'thad do/

/rdo rje 'dzin pa 'thad ldan gyis/ /kun da spong ba mi srid de/ /gsang dbang sogs la 'byin srid kyang*/ /bde chen rten du mi dgos zhes/ /spong sems skye ba ga la srid/ /skyes na rtsa ltung 'byung nges te/ /lam gyi rtsa ba'i rten yin phyir/ /dper na smon sems gtong ba bzhin/ /rig byed bzhi dang grub mtha' bzhi/ /mi rigs bzhi sogs dus 'khor gyi/ /zhal bzhi po las 'byung bshad pas/ /tshangs pa'i gzhung dang 'dra zer ba/ /'bras bu'i dus 'khor lha klu yi| |zhal las 'byung ba mi 'dod kyi/ /nges don gzhi yi dus 'khor gang*// gnyug ma'i thig le gzhom med la/ /gnas skabs bzhi po bskyed pa yi/ /nus pa'i sgo bzhi yod pa de/ /lus kyi snying kha la sogs pa'i/ /'khor lo bzhi la gnas pa yi/ /bag chags sad pa'i phyi rol gyi/ /snang ba bzhi tshan 'char bas na| |gzhi yi dus 'khor zhal bzhi las/ /'byung bar gsungs phyir snang ba kun| |phyi na tshugs thub med tshul la/ /nges pa ster bas mchog tu grub/ / gzung 'dzin goms pas 'di mi go /brjod du med pa'i gang zag ni/ /bye brag smra bas 'dod pa dang*/ kha che'i gzhung gis bdag med par/ /'dod pa khas blangs 'gal zer ba / / bye brag smra ba kha che bas/ khyab par 'dod pa bab col yin| |de la thams cad yod smra yis/ khyab ces zer ba'ang de dang 'dra/ / gnas ma bu sogs sde pa lnga/ /bdag 'di 'dod ces smra ba dang*/ /grub mtha' bzhi ru ma gtogs na/ /nang pa min par smra ba dang*/ /sde pa bco brgyad thub bstan las/ /gyes par smras rnams cis mi 'gal/ /rang gi nang 'gal mi rig par| |sa bcu pa la nang 'gal 'dzin/ /mdo sde pa yis rnam rig min/ /las gzhan thogs med gzugs 'dod ces/ /zer ba'ang shin tu mi rigs te/ /yang na dbang don gang rung zhig /thogs med nyid du 'dod pa'am/ /dbang don rig byed min pa las/ /gzhan pa'i thogs med gzugs 'dod pa'i/ /don smra de 'dra e ma mtshar/

/bsdus pos theg gsum bsdus pa dang*/ /glegs bam yi ger bris pa dang*/ /bod du bod skad bris pa sogs/ /byis pa'i dogs pa bkod par zad| |mkhas la 'os pa'i dogs mi snang*/ /de phyir 'di lan rgyas mi spro/ /lwa ba pa yis u rgyan nas/ /blangs pa'i rgyud rnams tshad ldan du/ /nges nas dus zhabs la sogs la/ /sdang ba'ang sdang zhugs tsam du zad/ /mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyis/ /kyai rdor nges don 'chad pa na/ /rgyud sde 'di nyid gtsor mdzad pas// tshad ma'i skyes bus 'di bzung ngo/ /shes rab rin chen lo tsā ba'i/ /rnam dpyod mkhar shar nyi ma'o/ /des na log lta'i rab rib rnams/ /yang dag rigs pa 'dis sel shog/ // maṅgalaṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/dus 'khor rtsod lan rigs pa'i 'od stong*/ -PAGE 386--PAGE 385-- PAGE 384-
